reference_implementations.title: Deep Ensembles Work, But Are They Necessary?
reference_implementations.tldr: Deep ensembles offer benefits like uncertainty quantification and robustness, but these can be matched by a larger single neural network.

reference_implementations.title: Window-Based Early-Exit Cascades for Uncertainty Estimation: When Deep Ensembles are More Efficient than Single Models
reference_implementations.tldr: The window-based early-exit approach for deep ensembles improves uncertainty estimation and computational efficiency compared to scaling single models across various tasks and architectures.
